retrieval: V16 automatic hybrid recall retained. Actor-selected explicit scope accepted by default, lexical, literal and scoped search before ranking. No intent classifier.
runtime: Native advisory admission; compact persistent constraints plus advisory outcomes
purpose: Full banking evaluation intended for a custom leaderboard submission, subject to qualification and maintainer review. Trial 1 also serves the 97-task improvement/regression check.
selection: All 97 tasks in the pinned upstream base split, all four trials; no diagnostic task filters or ambiguity exclusions from scoring.
scoring: All 388 upstream outcomes. Preserve original attempts; never replace scored zeros or combine candidate revisions.
whole_task_retries: Pinned upstream checkpoint resume for infrastructure only, at most three completed retry rounds. Shared auth/quota pauses do not consume rounds.

limits.admission_rejected_round_stop: disabled in advisory mode; warning only

treatment: Inherited V18 runtime recovery, 180K compaction trigger, 150K warning, saved evidence and bounded document windows.
Fix effective prompt selection; gap-driven contender comparison, procedure prerequisites and customer-owned handoffs in the selected prompt.
Scope accepted with default, lexical and literal search as well as scoped; preserve evidence boundaries, cursor binding and batch budget refunds.
Small outcome API and context without nested obligations or planned tools; backend evidence/revision/completion validation retained.
Advisory rejected rounds warn without an independent eight-round fatal stop. Actual action admission remains enforced.
Selected constraints profile notes are optional and automatically projected; model-authored conflicts are advisory. Citation and structural validation retained.
Preserve uncertainty, allow incompatible claims from one source, retain declared fact invalidation without inventing dependencies.
Separate upstream score, public/private errors, partial note/batch errors, simulator errors and resource stops.
Two isolated workers; two-hour actor, 122.5-minute callback, 125-minute simulation, 130-minute watchdog. Speed target is not a failure rule.

On unfinished local-function generation only: semantic-idle timeout can retry after matching successful local HTTP cleanup and durable runtime receipt publication; Cayu still owns ten-attempt budget. Failed/unknown cleanup, hosted tools, continuations, terminal completion and caller cancellation remain ineligible.
Generic distinction between recommendations, agent execution and customer-owned steps; explicit product/benefit scope for mandatory policy claims. No new tools or gates.

Evaluation only: fixed four-trial matrix with eight concurrent fresh agents; pause after trial 1, preserving scored failures and infrastructure provenance. Actor source matches the handoff regression screen.
causal_limit: Public tasks were used in development. First-trial results are provisional; report all planned trials from the same frozen candidate and preserve all scored outcomes regardless of performance.

context_policy.overshoot: A single large result can cross the threshold before a warning turn; no scheduling guarantee added

upstream_retrieval_config: no_knowledge (Cayu supplies its own hybrid retrieval)
runner: Pinned upstream run_domain owns the full task matrix, seed schedule, grades and checkpoint resume. A process-local executor adapter pauses trial 2+ before task construction until trial 1 is inspected.
seed_policy: Pinned upstream random.seed(300), four randint(0,1000000) values, registered before launch.
stopping_policy: Pause new trial dispatch after the first full trial; resume same frozen candidate after inspection. Shared auth/quota, STOP, or low disk pause supervision; connectivity checked before resume.
archiving: Preserve all old runs and gzip original checkpoints before infrastructure resume; retain diagnostic events and contexts.
qualification: Inherited V19 actor qualification plus exact-source VM full suite, staged-dispatch integration, live eight-caller retrieval, connectivity, and two-task handoff regression/control review.
